description: This Kotlin source file defines a PreviewParameterProvider class for Jetpack Compose previews, along with some sample data objects related to user news resources, topics, and user data within the Android app 'Now in Android'. It includes sample news resource data, topic definitions, and user settings used for previewing UI components.

classes.name: UserNewsResourcePreviewParameterProvider
classes.description: Provides a sequence of sample UserNewsResource lists for Compose previews.

methods.name: override val values
methods.description: Returns a sequence containing a list of sample UserNewsResource objects for preview purposes.
